about_the_game:
🗡️ Qilich Izidan – The Sword’s Trail

Step into the world of Qilich Izidan – The Sword’s Trail, a cinematic single-player parkour-adventure inspired by history, mystery, and legend.

When Amir Temur’s legendary sword is stolen, you set out on a dangerous journey to reclaim it and restore honor to your homeland.

Run, climb, and leap across ancient castles, forgotten ruins, and deadly landscapes. Each move could be your last — hidden blades, collapsing floors, and fiery traps test your reflexes and courage at every turn.

Solve clever puzzles, uncover hidden paths, and interact with environments that react to your every action. Master precision timing, stealth segments, and heart-pounding chases that blend seamlessly with a powerful story about heritage and destiny.

This game is built entirely by a single Uzbek developer — combining passion, creativity, and cinematic vision into one unforgettable experience.

⚔️ Key Features

  • Realistic parkour and climbing mechanics inspired by Uncharted and The Last of Us

  • Immersive sound design with dynamic footstep audio, echo effects, and environmental ambience

  • Challenging platforming and timing-based traps that reward patience and skill

  • Interactive puzzle 

  • Cinematic storytelling driven by Unity Timeline and real-time environments

Only the brave can follow the sword’s trail.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560, 2 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: none
